snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate mod - Scrolling Vanishing Island [SMBZ]
snippet.description:
Port of the Sm4sh stage mod "Scrolling Vanishing Island" I made by MiaoCat.
Represents the Super Mario Bros Z Episode 6 fightning location (Vanishing Island / Yoshi's Island). The episode can be found here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z0oO86-MgZc&t=577s&pp=ygUOc21ieiBlcGlzb2RlIDY%3D

----------------------------

Download link of the mod: https://gamebanana.com/mods/438308

Mods in this video:
Mecha Sonic + voice : https://gamebanana.com/mods/395401
Shadow : https://gamebanana.com/mods/425829
